description: This file contains implementation of logging utilities, including log formatting, initialization, and control functions for a logging system in C. It manages log levels, formatting, and output to various destinations, and includes functions for enabling/disabling logs and querying configurations.

methods.name: rdk_dbg_priv_LogControlInit
methods.description: Initializes the log control table with default and environment-based configurations.

methods.name: rdk_dbg_enabled
methods.description: Checks if a specific log level for a module is enabled.

methods.name: rdk_dbg_priv_SetLogLevelString
methods.description: Sets log levels for a specific module or default.

methods.name: rdk_dbg_priv_LogQueryOpSysIntf
methods.description: Provides a human-readable string of the current log configuration for a module.

methods.name: rdk_debug_priv_log_msg
methods.description: Logs a message at a specified level and module, formatting the message accordingly.

methods.name: RDK_LOG_ControlCB
methods.description: Callback to control logging levels for modules dynamically.

methods.name: initLogger
methods.description: Initializes the logging system with specific categories and appenders.

methods.name: dated_format_nocr
methods.description: Formats log events with date, time, priority, category, and message without line ending.

methods.name: basic_format_nocr
methods.description: Formats log events with priority, category, and message without line ending.

methods.name: comcast_dated_format_nocr
methods.description: Formats log events with date, microsecond timestamp, module, level, thread id, and message.

methods.name: stream_env_open
methods.description: Opens a log stream, parsing environment variables in the stream name.

methods.name: stream_env_append
methods.description: Appends a log event to the stream, handling different output targets.
